_comment: Terraform resource type -> the IAM actions a deploy role needs to manage it,
and how tightly they can be scoped. required-actions.py renders the event
stack's deploy policy from this for one environment; bootstrap-environment.sh
attaches it. Adding a resource type to the event root OR to modules/event-domain
means adding it here in the same change -- an unmapped type stops the derivation.
where echo manages the same type, because echo's list was corrected over nine
uat dispatches of apply-and-fix and its 'why' notes record each correction.
Scopes are the event stack's own: every ARN is pinned to {prefix} =
uif-event-{env}, so this grants nothing on any uif-echo-* resource.
modules/event-domain is covered too, deliberately: product's uat Terraform
instantiates it (uif-event-{env}-product bus, DLQ, DLQ->recorder mapping,
mapping upload) with the same uat role, and those resources live under this
EXPECT CORRECTIONS. apicurio needed five apply-and-fix rounds and echo nine;
the derivation sees the resources a stack declares and is blind to post-create
reads the provider makes around them.

lambda_esm.why: CreateEventSourceMapping, and Get/Update/Delete on a mapping, authorise on event-source-mapping:<uuid>, which is runtime-assigned and cannot carry the stack prefix.

events.why: A rule on a custom bus is rule/<bus>/<name>; the GoldMergeCompleted rule sits on {prefix}-bus, and the event-domain bus is {prefix}-<domain>.

glue_unscopable.why: glue:GetJobs and glue:GetTags take no job-scoped resource in the provider's calls (echo's map).

s3_stack_buckets.why: uif-event-{env}-release-artifacts and the state bucket uif-event-{env}-data. Both ARN forms: bucket-level and object-level actions.

gold_artifacts_event_objects.why: The event-domain module uploads each domain's mapping/seed under event-pipeline/domains/{domain}/ in echo's gold-artifacts bucket. Scoped to that prefix only: nothing here may write echo's gold files.

aws_iam_role.why: 7 roles. The List* calls are post-create reads the provider makes on every refresh (echo).

aws_iam_role_policy.why: Inline policies authorise against the ROLE's ARN.

aws_sqs_queue.why: trigger-dlq here; {prefix}-<domain>-dlq in event-domain. ListQueueTags is a separate 403 (echo).

aws_sqs_queue_policy.why: The policy IS a queue attribute.

aws_lambda_function.why: 4 functions. Code comes from the release-artifacts bucket (s3_key), and CreateFunction/UpdateFunctionCode read the zip with the CALLER's credentials -- hence s3:GetObject on it.

aws_lambda_event_source_mapping.why: subscription-configs stream -> provisioner here; <domain>-dlq -> dlq recorder in event-domain.

aws_cloudwatch_event_target.why: The GoldMergeCompleted target is a Lambda (resource policy), so no PassRole.

aws_cloudwatch_event_bus.why: event-domain's {prefix}-<domain> bus. The stack root declares no bus.

aws_dynamodb_table.why: 6 tables; subscription-configs has a stream. The Describe*/Update* pairs are separate 403s (echo).

aws_glue_job.why: publish + fabric-recovery. PassRole for the job role is in iam_stack_roles.

aws_s3_bucket.why: The release bucket. The long read list is the computed attributes aws_s3_bucket populates on every refresh (echo).

aws_region.why: Resolved from provider configuration; no API call.
